$comment: VAPP-85: the token NAMES the core catalog's macros and Box styles reference as `$<group>.<name>` (e.g. `$color.primary`, `$spacing.md`). VALUES come from a theme (VAPP-92); this file only fixes the vocabulary. `color` = the shadcn semantic set plus success/warning/info and the eight chart hues (round 1 added chart6..8); `spacing`/`radius`/`type` mirror packages/design-tokens' scales by NAME (xl2 because 2xl is not an identifier in Swift/Kotlin/Rust); `control` = the per-kind control heights the VAPP-4 spike asked for instead of px (round 1 adds `appBar`, `tabBar`, `toast`); `shadow` = the boxShadow presets, ALSO the elevation scale (none < sm < md < lg < xl: flat, card, popover, dialog, toast; paint order inside a layer stays tree order, overlays stack by layer, never by zIndex); `opacity` = the text-emphasis ladder; VAPP-92 adds `border` (the border-width ladder, px) and `motion` (durations, ms). Round 1 (docs/round-1-contract.md) adds `breakpoint` (px, the ONLY tokens a style CONDITION may reference: `"@media (min-width: $breakpoint.md)"`; resolved against the theme before matching), `ease` (cubic-bezier control points [x1, y1, x2, y2], referenced by `transitionEasing`) and `density` (multipliers over `control` and `spacing` for the surface density `compact`/`comfortable`; `default` = 1, never a token). Round 2 (docs/round-2-contract.md §2) adds `blur` (px radii, the ONLY values `backdropBlur` takes). EXP-1259 (EXP-1243, packages/design-tokens motion.scale) adds `scale` (unitless multipliers the PAINTERS read, never a style value): `press` = what a pressed button scales to, `popoverFrom` = what a popover or menu scales FROM while it fades in (never from 0); reduce motion = no scale. VAPP-162 appends `type.family.serif` (the platform's system serif, `ui-serif` in every built-in theme). #VAPP-258 appends `color.link` (a link's ink; a theme chain that sets none takes `primary`, so older themes stay complete). #EXP-1629 appends `shadow.popover` (a floating picker's elevation: the exponential theme's = gpui's `shadow_lg`, two layers; neutral = its `md`). #EDE-65 appends `color.borderStrong` (the stronger stroke: an outgoing chat bubble's edge, the IDE's glass STROKE_STRONG; a chain that sets none takes `border`). #EXP-1629 appends `color.ghostHover` (a ghost button's hover fill, the IDE picker row's value button: gpui-component's ghost hover, the exponential theme's = half the glass active fill in dark and gpui-component's light `accent` in light; a chain that sets none takes `accent`), `strokeActive` (a focused box field's stroke: web's `focus-visible:border-glass-stroke-active`, the IDE's `chrome.stroke_active`; the exponential theme's = the glass `strokeActive` in dark and the light `ring` in light; a chain that sets none takes `ring`). #EXP-1629 appends `color.destructiveHover` (a destructive menu item's highlight: web's `focus:bg-destructive/10`, `dark:focus:bg-destructive/20`; a chain that sets none takes `destructive` at 10 % alpha in light and 20 % in dark). Every group is append-only: a theme is validated against these names. #EXP-1760 appends `shadow.popoverRing` (gpui-component's popover SURFACE, `popover_style`: a 1 px ring of the foreground at 10 % outside the box + shadcn's `md`; the IDE's icon and colour pickers; a chain that sets none takes `popover`).
